content_html_sanitized:
Posted May 4, 2004
From Richard Cowan To the Readers of MarijuanaNews

Dear Friends:

I am very pleased to tell you that Advanced Nutrients of Abbotsford, BC, is acquiring MarijuanaNews.com in a transaction will allow me to continue to fight the good fight for at least another year. It also assures that the future of the website will no longer depend precariously on my ability to support it.

Advanced Nutrientsis a leading supplier of plant nutrients to the horticultural industry, and they are generous supporters of medical cannabis patients who can grow their own medicine in Canada. My good friends the Kubbys rave about the spectacular results that they are getting from the nutrients donated to them by Advanced. Most important, the people at Advanced are absolutely committed to ending cannabis prohibition.

You will not see any immediate change in the appearance of MarijuanaNews, but as time allows, Advanced will be giving it a badly needed facelift.

I will also be working with Advanced to help them set up a new Internet video news magazine, where I will be doing a weekly news program, and perhaps other things as well.

Unfortunately, this means that I will be leaving Pot-TV, so I would like to thank Marc Emery and Chris Bennett for the opportunity to work with them, and we will of course continue to collaborate in the struggle for freedom.

In addition to assuring the future of MarijuanaNews, the association with Advanced will mean a wider audience for the website. I have not had the time, resources or the skills needed to promote the site and thereby increase traffic. Advanced Nutrients technical team will be invaluable in reaching more people, and that is the key to victory.

Consequently, I am happy for many reasons to be able to work with Advanced Nutrients, and to share this good news with you.

Richard Cowan
